statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The denial reason code is CO-197

Mobile cardiac telemetry was medically necessary to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or ischemic changes
